explanation: Gustavus had sat in front of Wallenstein’s entrenchments at Zirndorf since July. He could not storm them or starve them out. The siege’s own article says the assault at the Alte Veste was undertaken to end that deadlock. The article reads: "To try to break the deadlock, 25,000 men under Gustavus attacked the Imperial entrenchments in the Battle of the Alte Veste on 3 September but failed to break through, having lost 2,500 men compared to 900 Imperials."
